name: Block Masjid
summary: A stepped dome, square entrance, and tiered minaret build a mosque from bold grid-aligned shapes.
why: The continuous silhouette turns a pixel-grid language into recognizable mosque architecture. Large blocks keep the dome and doorway clear, while a warm ochre minaret introduces a second architectural rhythm.
risk: The block geometry can suggest retro games or construction. It suits a confident playful identity more than a traditional ornamental one.
reasonToChoose: You want a friendly digital identity with an unusually bold mosque shape.
